WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    SUM(res.points) as total_points
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
avg_total_stat AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total FROM race_totals
),
kept_races AS (
  SELECT rt.name, rt.total_points
  FROM race_totals rt
  WHERE rt.total_points > (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_total_stat)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM kept_races) as sum_kept_total_points,
  AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps_all_results,
  (SELECT AVG(total_points - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_total_stat)) FROM kept_races) as avg_excess
FROM kept_races kr
JOIN races r ON r.name = kr.name
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.laps IS NOT NULL
